newsitem.title: USA: Texas electricity prices again steady on weather.
newsitem.headline: Texas electricity prices again steady on weather.

text.p: Spot electricity prices in the Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT) again held steady Thursday with mild weather dominating the state and stifling demand, industry sources said.
Temperatures in Texas reached the mid-50s degree Fahrenheit range overnight, with highs through the state Thursday in southern Texas in the mid-80s.
On-peak firm ERCOT power for Friday delivery was talked steady in the $17.80-18.80 range, the brokers and marketers said.
Off-peak firm next-day power was said to be offered as low as $9.00 and $11.00 per MWh with no takers due to the very low demand.
November ERCOT power was discussed steady at $18.00-19.00.
-- Chris Reese, New York Power Desk 212-859-1627
